title: Warm Lacquer Glazed Vietnamese Zucchini Bo Kho
description: A fresh and crisp Vietnamese dish featuring zucchini in a lacquer glaze, served in a claypot, vegan-friendly and perfect for meal prep. This bo kho recipe is a twist on traditional Vietnamese cuisine.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a claypot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Add the bruised lemongrass and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced zucchini and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 10 minutes, or until the zucchini is tender.
Stir in the lacquer glaze and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the glaze is bubbly and slightly thickened.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until heated through.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
